title: Could Manuel Neuer save the Titanic?
caption: Could Manuel Neuer save the Titanic? We did the maths. Nobody asked. 🧊⚽ #could #manuelneuer #titanic #documentary #football #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Manuel Neuer save the Titanic from sinking? {{ev}}We looked at the evidence. ||0.25|| {{sci}}Scientifically. ||0.3|| {{long}}And for far too long.

Subject A. {{name}}The R M S Titanic. {{tons}}Fifty two thousand tonnes of Edwardian confidence. {{uns}}Officially, practically unsinkable. {{date}}In April {1912|nineteen twelve}, it met an iceberg. ||0.6|| {{won}}The iceberg won.

Subject B. {{name}}Manuel Neuer. {{h}}{1.93|One point nine three} metres of German goalkeeper. {{wc}}World champion, {2014.|twenty fourteen.} {{out}}Widely credited with inventing the act of leaving his own goal for no apparent reason. {{ice}}He has stopped thousands of fast-moving objects. ||0.45|| {{zero}}None of them were icebergs.

Plan A. {{t}}The punch. {{ball}}A football weighs {0.43|zero point four three} kilograms. {{berg}}The iceberg weighed an estimated {1.5|one point five} million tonnes. {{ratio}}That is roughly {3.5|three and a half} billion footballs. ||0.45|| {{busy}}A busy evening, even for Neuer.

Plan B. {{t}}The sweeper keeper. {{look}}The lookout spotted the iceberg about {37|thirty seven} seconds before impact. {{run}}Neuer sprints the {269|two hundred and sixty nine} metre deck in {34.|thirty four.} {{spare}}He reaches the bridge with three seconds to spare, {{shout}}and does what goalkeepers do best. ||0.5|| {{he}}He shouts.

Plan C. {{t}}The bucket. {{in}}Water entered the ship at an estimated {400|four hundred} tonnes per minute. {{scoop}}At two litres per scoop, Neuer needs {{rate}}{3,300|three thousand, three hundred} scoops per second. {{pump}}At that point, he is not a goalkeeper. ||0.5|| {{is}}He is a pump.

The verdict. {{q}}Could Manuel Neuer save the Titanic? ||0.8|| {{no}}No. ||0.9|| {{line}}But no goalkeeper in history would have come further off his line. {{p1}}Chance of success: {0.03|zero point zero three} percent. {{p2}}Chance he tries anyway: ||0.35|| {{p3}}{100%.|one hundred.}
Who should we send next? {{c}}Tell us in the comments.
